entity.summary: Digital-asset platform founded in the United Arab Emirates and currently offering spot trading, OTC execution, conversion, custody, and related services through region-specific M2 entities.
entity.notes: Current first-party fee and account materials expose spot trading and OTC services and identify M2 Global Wealth Limited as the Bahamas-regulated global operator. A separate UAE M2 Custody Limited entity provides ADGM-regulated custody; HEI does not extend that custody authorization to every exchange service. Independent exchange profiling recognizes M2 but currently reports untracked volume, so the record remains limited rather than active. No unsupported exact launch date, predecessor, successor, terminal state, or incident event is asserted.

evidence.title: M2 Fees
evidence.notes: Current first-party fee page exposes spot-trading maker and taker fees and identifies M2 Global Wealth Limited as the Bahamas-regulated operator of the global M2 trading name.

evidence.title: About M2 Accounts
evidence.notes: First-party product guide describes current Global Account access to spot trading, deposits, withdrawals, conversion, OTC, and earn-account transfers.

evidence.title: M2 exchange profile
evidence.notes: Independent exchange profile recognizes M2 as a UAE-founded global crypto platform with the current m2.com domain but reports volume as untracked, supporting limited rather than active classification.
